## Checklist

- [ ] A maintainer explicitly agreed to this work before implementation.
- [ ] The pull request contains no unrelated refactoring or formatting changes.
- [ ] Public API or behavior changes are documented.
- [ ] I have disclosed any material use of AI-assisted coding tools.
- [ ] I reviewed and tested the submitted code and have the right to contribute it under MIT.
